author: Brandjuh
name: CuffDetective
description: Ask the precinct detective with the detective command or by @mentioning the bot. Shared precinct-wide rate budget with a 'desk pile' queue, short-lived per-channel conversation memory, and a channel-locked desk. Port of the Node CuffBot detective module.
end_user_data_statement: This cog keeps a short-lived, in-memory conversation history per channel (30 minutes). Nothing is persisted to disk.
